title: require_scope does not check parent scopes
description: api.rs:248-256. The require_scope method checks for exact string match of the scope. A token with scope 'read write' will match checks for 'read' or 'write' (individual words). But a check for 'write:statuses' will fail because the scope string only contains 'write', not 'write:statuses'. The Mastodon API uses hierarchical scopes where 'write' grants all 'write:*' sub-scopes. Currently no callers use sub-scopes (all checks are for 'write' or 'read'), but when a contributor adds a check for 'write:statuses' or 'read:accounts', it will incorrectly reject tokens with the parent scope.
